displayName: Dermal Filler Consent + Pre/Post Care Bundle
description: Complete clinical documentation for dermal filler treatments — lips, cheeks, jawline, tear troughs, and full-face volumization. Includes consultation screening, informed consent, treatment records, and patient education handouts. Editable in Canva.
targetBuyer: Nurse injectors, NPs, PAs, and med spa owners offering HA fillers, Sculptra, Radiesse, or biostimulators

templates.name: Dermal Filler Consultation & Medical History Form
templates.description: Pre-treatment screening including Tyndall risk assessment, allergy history, prior filler disclosures, and vascular anatomy awareness

templates.name: Dermal Filler Informed Consent Form
templates.description: Comprehensive consent covering vascular occlusion risk, bruising, asymmetry, longevity, and dissolution options

templates.name: Pre-Treatment Instructions — Dermal Filler
templates.description: 1-week and 24-hour pre-care instructions to minimize bruising and swelling

templates.name: Post-Treatment Aftercare Instructions — Dermal Filler
templates.description: Aftercare covering icing protocol, activity restrictions, massage guidance, and swelling timeline

templates.name: Filler Treatment Record & Product Log
templates.description: Per-visit documentation with injection zone diagram, product name, lot number, syringe volume, and anatomical placement notes

templates.name: Hyaluronidase Dissolution Consent Form
templates.description: Separate consent for hyaluronidase (Hylenex) dissolution procedures covering risks, allergic reaction protocol, and re-treatment timeline

templates.name: Before/After Photography Consent
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant photo consent with tiered options: clinical only, marketing, and social media

deliveryNote: All templates open in Canva as your own editable copy. Customize with your clinic name, provider credentials, and any state-required disclosures. Have your medical director review consent language before clinical use.
_autoMatchNote: Suggested URLs come from Canva list-designs edit URLs (temporary). Review before import.
